method: Manual visual inspection of unretouched source frames, full-resolution five-angle strips, and enlarged previews of the first three full-body poses. Angles are artistic targets, not measured camera poses.

characters.name: John
characters.head: generated/john-head-angles-v1.png
characters.observed: Wide rounded U-shaped lower jaw and long J-shaped nose preserved. Both eyes visible in three-quarter heads; profiles have one eye and a protruding nose silhouette.

characters.name: Paul
characters.head: generated/paul-head-angles-v1.png
characters.observed: Short small nose, large expressive eyes and softer compact jaw separate Paul from John and George. Three-quarter and profile differ in far-eye visibility and near-cheek width.

characters.name: George
characters.head: generated/george-head-angles-v1.png
characters.observed: Narrow angular lower face, long straight pointed nose, heavy brows and pointed nape tufts retained. Three-quarter retains a small far eye; pure profile hides it.

characters.name: Ringo
characters.head: generated/ringo-head-angles-v1.png
characters.observed: Large pear-shaped nose and tiny chin retained. Whole body sheet regenerated after two local edits failed to expose the far eye. Selected v5 top-row second pose now visibly has both eyes and an oblique nose, while third pose has one eye and a protruding side silhouette.

limitations: Supplemental generated drawings, not archival cels or exact reproductions of a specific episode frame.
Head angles are approximate cartoon projections; the far eye can be small at normal pet size.
These reference sheets have not been validated as an importable pet animation atlas.
